role: user-supplied Premium current/reference enrichment and validated standalone historical workbook display; never a PIT clock
reason: Only user-supplied/manual Screener Premium exports and workbooks are accepted. The application does not crawl Screener.in, call it at runtime, or treat Screener current observations as historical point-in-time evidence.
permitted_use: Populate current/reference company facts and display validated standalone historical workbook content with explicit Screener provenance, subject to deterministic identity checks.
reconsideration_gate: Any future automated acquisition, licensed API, redistribution, or broader provider use requires a separate policy and rights review.
prohibited_use: Automated crawling or provider requests during page navigation/runtime
Using Screener current/reference observations as historical PIT timestamps
Backdating current Screener values into Research V2 cohorts
Overwriting frozen Research V2 PIT factors or eligibility with Screener current/reference values
Accepting quarantined or conflicting identity matches

identity_match_policy.fallback: one unique ACCEPTED row matching primary exchange plus exchange security ID; current/reference only
identity_match_policy.canonical_identity: canonical ISIN is never replaced; provider/source ISIN is retained separately

current_reference_precedence.preservation: provider observations and provenance are retained rather than averaged

pit_boundary.screener_role: no Screener current/reference observation is a PIT clock
pit_boundary.research_v2: official filing evidence plus official exchange dissemination/availability timing only
pit_boundary.historical_workbook_identity: historical/workbook evidence retains exact canonical-ISIN semantics; current/reference exchange-code fallback is not propagated into PIT
